newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST- Orion 8-mth profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Orion 8-mth profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 536 million markka median forecast for pharmaceuticals maker Orion-yhtyma Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 10 at 0830/0530 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Orion posted a 528 million markka profit.
For Orion's full-year 1996 profit, eight of the 10 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 770 million markka (mean 757 million) in a 685-786 million markka range.
On June 12, Orion said it saw no reason to change its earlier full-year 1996 forecast, that net sales and profit developments may level off after profit rose 27 percent in January-April.
Orion's 1995 profit before extraordinary items was 670 million markka. @
The data was collected in the first week of October and on October 8.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aros, Carnegie, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Paribas.
